exposure: Gestational age at delivery (term vs. preterm)
Lifestyle intervention group vs. control group
Antibiotic treatment during pregnancy and postpartum
Women with ear, nose, and throat (ENT) infections
outcome: Frequency of antibiotic treatment during pregnancy and postpartum
cohort: 1636 women from the 'Healthy Living in Pregnancy' (GeliS) study
finding: Approximately one in five women receives at least one antibiotic treatment during pregnancy and breastfeeding that meets current treatment recommendations, with treatment being more common in premature births, cesarean sections, and breastfeeding women.
mod_finding: Antibiotic treatment was more common in women who gave birth by cesarean section (p = 0.003).
